summary: Frontend-only end-to-end validation completed on public URL for contract signature enhancements and Product Business Management template flows. All requested critical flows passed, including signature live preview, draw/upload controls, exports, product modules, purchase/sale inventory synchronization, pricing save, template exports, mobile overflow checks, and console health.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical defects reproduced for requested scope.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://freelancer-admin.preview.emergentagent.com/startup, /startup/product-business-management, and /startup/consulting-client-contract. Confirmed Startup Toolkit Product Business card routing. rca of the issue: No issue RCA required in this iteration because no blocking or major defect was reproduced.
